NISSERVER.description: Whether to start the ypserv daemon. Set to 'true' to enable.

NISMASTER.description: The hostname of the NIS master server, if this machine is a slave.

YPPWDDIR.description: The directory where password files are located for yppasswd.

YPCHANGEOK.description: The command allowed for changing user information.

YPSERVARGS.description: Additional arguments to pass to the ypserv daemon.

YPPASSWDDARGS.description: Additional arguments to pass to the yppasswdd daemon.

YPXFRDARGS.description: Additional arguments to pass to the ypxfrd daemon.

YPPWDDIRARGS.description: Additional arguments to pass to the yppwddir daemon.
